The plate is square and about 26 cm across, so I used the dinner-plate size as the ruler.

- **Spinach:** The pile covers about 12 × 14 cm and is loosely stacked, perhaps 3–4 cm high. I estimate about 45 g.
- **Corn cob slice:** It is about 4 cm across and 2 cm thick, so roughly 25 g.
- **Other visible items:** There are a few scattered corn kernels or small bits, plus some broccoli at the edge of the pile. I put the broccoli at about 10 g and the kernels at about 5 g.
